contract.note: The historical labor-saving comparison is an ordinary reading. Accounting for oversight fairly measures realized savings, and the contract imposes no deadline.

evidence.note: The pre-cutoff preprint documents adoption using OpenAI usage data. Adoption and output tokens do not establish net time savings or historical significance; company data are not independent confirmation.
The pre-cutoff METR update reports tentative developer speedups with substantial measurement limitations. Neither these results nor earlier slowdowns settle eventual historical-scale savings.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes neither historically consequential realized time savings nor permanent impossibility. No deadline exists, and neither adoption growth nor narrow productivity results meet the early-resolution rule.
